question: Who became the youngest undisputed World Chess Champion in history by defeating Ding Liren in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**D Gukesh**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **D Gukesh**, full name **Dommaraju Gukesh**, became the **youngest undisputed World Chess Champion in history** in **2024** by defeating the reigning champion, **Ding Liren**.
 
• At the time of his victory, **D Gukesh** was only **18 years old**, making him the youngest player ever to achieve this feat. This surpassed the previous record set by **Garry Kasparov** in **1985**, who won the World Chess Championship at the age of **22**.
 
• The victory of **D Gukesh** was celebrated worldwide as a landmark achievement, and it further established **India** as a prominent force in the world of chess.
 
• **Gukesh** is part of a new wave of Indian chess prodigies, alongside other young talents such as **R Praggnanandhaa** and **Nihal Sarin**, showcasing the immense growth of chess in **India**.
 
• His victory was also significant as it marked the continuation of a trend where younger players are increasingly challenging and defeating the established champions in chess.

**Additional Information__**

__
 
• **D Gukesh:**

 
 
• **D Gukesh** was born on **May 29, 2006**, in **Chennai, India**. He is considered one of the brightest stars in Indian chess.
 
• He became the **second-youngest Grandmaster in history** at the age of **12 years, 7 months, and 17 days** in **2019**.
 
• Gukesh’s rise in the chess world has been meteoric. He has won multiple international and national tournaments, proving his extraordinary talent and dedication.
 
 
 
• **World Chess Championship:**
 
 
• The **World Chess Championship** is the most prestigious title in the game of chess. It has been held since **1886** and has a rich history of legendary champions such as **Garry Kasparov**, **Magnus Carlsen**, and **Viswanathan Anand**.
 
• The championship involves a series of qualifying tournaments and matches where the best players in the world compete for the title.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Explained:**
 
 
• **Magnus Carlsen:** The Norwegian chess legend was the World Chess Champion from **2013** to **2023**. He chose not to defend his title in **2024**.
 
• **Viswanathan Anand:** The Indian chess icon was the World Chess Champion from **2007** to **2013**. He is regarded as the pioneer of Indian chess.
 
• **R Praggnanandhaa:** Another Indian chess prodigy, he gained international recognition for defeating **Magnus Carlsen** in multiple games. However, he has not yet won the World Chess Championship.
 
 

**Important Points__**

 
• **Chess in India:**

 
 
• India has emerged as a global chess powerhouse, with numerous young players achieving significant milestones in recent years.
 
• The **All India Chess Federation (AICF)** has played a crucial role in promoting the game through tournaments, training programs, and scholarships.
 
 
 
• **Future of Chess:**
 
 
• The success of players like **D Gukesh** and **R Praggnanandhaa** inspires a new generation of chess enthusiasts in **India**.
 
• The advancements in chess training, including the use of **AI-based tools** and computer analysis, have revolutionized the game and provided young players with unprecedented opportunities to excel.
